name: Skeleton
description: A placeholder element that indicates content is loading. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: animation
props.description: Controls the animation style of the skeleton.

props.name: shape
props.description: Controls the border radius of the skeleton.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls the height of the skeleton.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
